title: A General Framework for Learning Algebraic Properties from Cayley Graphs using Graph Neural Networks
summary: In this work, we present a general Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework for learning algebraic properties of finite groups from their Cayley graph representations. The framework provides a unified computational pipeline consisting of a common graph construction procedure, feature representation, training methodology, and GNN architecture, with only the target labeling function varying across classification tasks.
